questions.question: What is the late fee on overdue amounts under the Acme agreement?
questions.answer: The late fee on overdue amounts is one and a half percent (1.5%) per month, calculated daily from the Due Date until the date of actual payment [1].

questions.question: What early payment discount does Acme offer?
questions.answer: Acme offers an early payment discount of two percent (2%) of the invoice amount excluding GST if the Customer pays the invoice in full within ten (10) days of the Invoice Date [1].

questions.question: How many days after the invoice date is payment due under the supply agreement?
questions.answer: Under the Acme Supply Agreement, the "Due Date" is defined as the date falling thirty (30) days after the Invoice Date [2].

questions.question: How much notice do we need to give to end the supply contract without cause?
questions.answer: To terminate the Acme supply contract for convenience (without cause), you must give not less than sixty (60) days' written notice [1].

questions.question: What percentage of the order value is paid in advance?
questions.answer: The advance payment is 20% of the order value [3].

questions.question: How much is payable when goods are dispatched?
questions.answer: According to the Acme Supply Agreement, 70% of the order value is payable by the Due Date upon dispatch [1].

questions.question: When is the final 10% of the order value payable?
questions.answer: The final 10% of the order value is payable 30 days after delivery [3].
